title: Patient Payment Plans Fee and Installment Schedule
content:
Schedule of the term, installment floor, down payment, setup fee and interest rate of every tier of the Patient Payment Plans.

| Tier | Term (monthly installments) | Minimum monthly installment (USD) | Down payment (% of the initially enrolled balance) | Minimum down payment where a down payment applies (USD) | One-time setup fee (USD) | Annual percentage rate (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Interest-Free Plan | 3 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 6-Month Interest-Free Plan | 6 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 12-Month Interest-Free Plan | 12 | 35.00 | 10.00 | 50.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 18-Month Extended Plan | 18 | 50.00 | 10.00 | 150.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 |
| 24-Month Extended Plan | 24 | 75.00 | 15.00 | 250.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 |
| Financial Hardship Plan | 36 | 15.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

Footnotes:

1. *Term* is the number of monthly installments the enrolled balance is spread over.
2. *Down payment* is expressed as a percentage, to two decimals, and is due at signing.
3. *Setup fee* is a one-time fee added to the plan balance at signing.
4. *Annual percentage rate* is the rate charged on the plan balance; it is 0.00 on every tier.

Tiers at a glance:

- A setup fee above 0.00 is scheduled only for the 18-Month Extended Plan and the 24-Month Extended Plan, at 25.00 each.
- A down payment percentage above 0.00 is scheduled for the 12-Month Interest-Free Plan (10.00 percent, minimum 50.00), the 18-Month Extended Plan (10.00 percent, minimum 150.00) and the 24-Month Extended Plan (15.00 percent, minimum 250.00).
- The Financial Hardship Plan carries the longest term, 36 installments, and the lowest installment floor, 15.00.
